investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Provided the victim was under16 an act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which, constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom. (section 72 and Sch 2).
(ii) A person convicted of this offence and sentenced to a term of imprisonment, detained in a hospital or made the subject of a community sentence of at least 12 months is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act. (Sch 3 paragraph 25).
(iii) See section 21 of the Act for interpretation of the term "position of trust".
(iv) See also H5724 for the offence where the offender is in a position of trust other than as provided by section 21 of the Act.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
